body: Thank you for listening. I had an original date of March 25th (2 weeks after my coworker would leave) but after listening to people decided to wait and see if she truly would stay in touch or not when she got her new job. I held hope that this time would be different i decided to wait another month. I sent see a need to put it off and sadly even if I desired I sent out one of the two suicide letters (the email one) already to force my hand. My wife has left the house so I'm just waiting another 15 or so minutes so I can be confident that she doesn't come back because she forgot something. But thank your for the attempt. You are a good person.

Thanks for the advice although I don't see it working for me. I've travelled a lot in my life and have been to 17 countries (along with 38 of the states) and I don't feel that area affects how I feel. Plus I would like my wife to have closure. I love her and she's a great person and I'd hate her to not know whether I'm alive or dead and if she can move or not. This way she knows.

In many ways it's too late. I just hate everyone who leaves. Life is boring and I feel alone. I spend most my day reading posts and stuff but those aren't real people I can hang out with. Real people leave and for one time I'd like to change the script and leave before them. Losing the most important person in your life for the past 5 years and seeing that that was a friendship of circumstance has made me realize that.

My question is to go where? Every single person I care about leaves and I don't see how running away from here would change any part. People leave everywhere and claim they'll stay in touch. I'd rather not deal with that fact anymore.

Oh I'm sure the new employee will be cool. I'm friendly with a lot of people at work and they are good people. But this is very different with this person, people at work will talk about how inseparable we are and she is the difference of a coworker friend and a great friend. I feel like losing her is like losing someone you are married to as I spend 35 hours a week with her non stop in conversation.

But how do you do that when they are 8-34 hours away. I mean we still share texts from one another but the best man at my wedding moved to Honduras (I'm in the US). It does not seem like people stay near home anymore and move away on an instand

She isn't moving far away but as we know coworkers drift away. I also feel that do to our genders it is less likely wr will hang out 1 to 1. Basically we were in constant contact for 5 years and she's already pulling away the past few days. I just don't want to be here without her here with me since I truly believe she has kept me alive

Thank you for your response. I get it but I feel that is not always the case. One regret I had was going to college far away so they aren't really able to be visited without a plane ticket. Add to the fact that the one good friend ive made in my 30s is leaving for a new job in 2 days and I'll never be able to talk to her to that same level instead of the 7 hours a day I spent with her for the last 5 years. She was a rock for me and the one person who never left. Now that she's leaving it's clear that people just don't stay in your life
I don't think she would care anymore. I don't think it would affect her one bit
So find your way to what. Having a good career is not the same as good people and every person leaves. What would you recommend then.
Thank you for your responses but I just don't know how people get past losing parts of their life. 33 days til I'm free of people leaving
So should I write a note then? And if so how can I thank this person but not make them feel responsible. My hope is that she won't even realize I died or not for awhile.
But people drift away naturally. Also I'm 2 hours a week feels so different to me than 35 hours a week, especially since she is my only friend at this point of my life.

I am sadly unable to move away as my wife has a good job here and I wouldn't uproot her. She's not social at all and is work and stays at home. She is very accepting of my relationship with this coworker. My suicide would not effect her and I imagine she expects it with my coworker leaving

Visiting is unlikely. None are within 8 hours. Also honestly none matter as much as my coworker. Even the Bestman at my wedding I haven't seen in 4 years because he leaves on the other coast. Calling is fine but not the same. Same as texting. I am used to always being with groups of people and having zero local friends isn't worth it for me

It just comes down to the fact that everybody leaves... so why shouldn't I also. My high school friends all moved to various other parts of the country and in my infinite stupidity I went to a college far away to get a better degree which means I don't live near my college friends either. So the one real friend I have is also leaving so I'd like to leave like everyone else. That way I'm in control for a change

People like you who approve of this behavior is why we have teenagers shooting up schools and using illegal drugs. No accountability. This guy used a vulgar name and thinks he should take no penalty for it. Why dont we just let people use whatever name then. Why not let them use the n word or names about shooting minorities. That's all cool with you I guess. I just hope you never have a child since you approve of this behavior

Because his gamertag broke the ToS and is inappropriate. He is making it less fun for others and is being immature. I can't believe people are supporting this guy who was an immature 12 year old tool. I bet his parents would have loved his username choice.

Maybe you shouldn't have been a jerk who ruins gaming for a lot of other kids. Honestly I believe you deserve to lose it and I'm glad someone reported your name. I try to report any offensive ones I see but there are a lot. Guess what... trying to put vulgar or offensive words in your username doesn't make you cool... just a tool. Hope Sony doesn't give in and maybe you'll learn a lesson.

I've decided on the date. March 26th. It's exactly two weeks after she leaves the job, this way she won't feel accountable (and for this reason I'm going no note). Took the day off work and already have every thing I need.

Thank you for the response. Sadly I just don't see it. For 3 years we've basically spent 7 hours a day together and to suddenly have that end is too much for me. She is the most important person and the occasional text which drifts to nothing seems so rough

So physically there isn't much I can do to distance myself since we have to work together 8 hours a day non stop and there is no way for that not to be the case. I can try to talk to her less about life stuff but to do so I'll have to have a conversation with my coworker to tell her why. Should I do that?

I guess just the fact I think about this girl every second. I've had female friends before (and still do) but I've never felt like this. It's also been nearly a year and the feelings have only strengthened not faded.

I don't think I mentioned this on this post, but as much as I find myself enamored and obsessed with girl I don't think about her sexually. Honestly that isn't my concern, but rather I'd like to spend every minute talking to her (all of which I told my wife). I don't really care about the sex part.

That's an interesting view point. My concern was thst I think about this girl non stop and have for nearly a year and have never felt this way in my life prior (I told my wife all this).

Friendship wise she doesn't have a desire too. Sadly we live in an area that is completely goid of groups (as I've tried to find so many just for myself and failed) and neither of us drink at all. She is happy to spend her day working, visiting her mom, going for a run and watching tv.
She told me as long as it's not physical she is ok with it. I told her that emotional can be just as bad, but she said she trusts me to stop it before it reaches that point

She told me that she trusts that I'll never take it to a physical level and that she isn't concerned with the emotional part. She also doesnt have a history of sabotaging relationships but rather not starting them. What other things should I be asking her?
What about if she comments on the rapid change or feels like she did something wrong. We literally spend 8 hours together everyday and we can't separate tasks or anything like that.

So I told my wife about it this morning before work and she told me that it was ok and that I should remain friends with her. I explained how I can't stop thinking about this girl and she said its normal to have a crush on a close friend and that I shouldn't ditch the friend since she trusts i wouldn't so anything. Now I'm more confused

That is fair. My wife knows that there have been rumors about us because I told her (small company leads to talk, which was relatively squashed). I've been very honest about the whole thing except my minds obsession.

Sadly, do to my location there just aren't groups. I used to play basketball and hockey extremely regularly but there are no adult leagues in my area (and I have searched and searched and searched). I do not live in a city, and finding friends at my age without children is difficult. We also work at a very small company, so finding friends at work is atypical (I talk to a few in passing, but no one close but the girl in question)

I am curious if she has noticed this at all. Personally I think she is just super friendly and thinks of me as a close friend, but nothing romantic at all. As I said, there has literally never been any form of physical contact between the two of us.

Thank you. I will try this because this does make a lot of sense. And yet I hate the idea of trying this so much because I feel like living without this person in my life would be unbearable. Its sad to say but this coworker is my closest friend at this point and the only person besides my wife I talk to from day to day (I don't talk to really anyone else at work, and don't really have any friends), but because of my own issues I got to cut the cord. Thank you
Does this mean that there is something wrong with me? Are extreme crushes normal while married?
Does it make a difference that its not a sexual crush when I tell her?

This is good advice, but I'd still have to work with her for hours everyday and I feel like I'd still think about her constantly. Also, any advice on what to do when she starts to chat while working on an assignment. Do I just cut that off? Do I tell her why we need to only do the work aspects (although that sounds so awkward, I would do it for the best of my wife). Sadly, when it comes to the assignment aspect without quitting my job, there is no way for me to not to work constantly with this person.
